periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, sloping downwards toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Distinctly oval-shaped, with the vertical axis significantly longer than the horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering, with the lower extremity of the patch extending further from the geometric center than the upper edge.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Prominent thickness, occupying approximately 45% of the visible lateral torso from the shoulder down.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: A wide separation across the crown, approximately equal to 1.2 times the transverse width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded and convex top boundaries with no visible flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-brown chromatic shift in the fur across the abdominal and ventral regions compared to the white cranial fur.
